title: QuickShulker Multi
description: Quickly open shulker boxes(and more) without placing them down. Refactor by preprocessor
body:
# Quick Shulker Multi
Quickly open shulker boxes(and more) without placing them down and refactor using [preprocessor](https://github.com/Fallen-Breath/preprocessor)  
Support Minecraft from 1.20.6 to latest
Welcome to add localization to this project!

Use the multi-version build tool preprocessor to build mods for multiple Minecraft versions quickly.

This project's upstream [MoRanpcy/quickshulker](https://github.com/MoRanpcy/quickshulker) updates [kyrptonaught](https://github.com/kyrptonaught)'s [QuickShulker](https://github.com/kyrptonaught/quickshulker) mod to higher Minecraft versions and fixes something.

Quick Shulker has multiple configurable methods to open, all of which you can enable/disable:

- Pressing a keybind while holding the item
- Right clicking while holding the item
- Pressing the keybind while hovering over the item in your inventory
- Right clicking the item while hovering over in your inventory

Shulkers(and others) can now be interacted with like bundles in your inventory!

- Right click a shulker with an item to insert that item into the shulker
- Right click an item with the shulker to pickup and insert that item.
- Right click an item slot while holding a shulker to extract the last item in the shulker to that spot.

^Each one of these can be disable in the config
